preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): 1 <= k[i] < n[i] <= 2*10**5
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of friends k is less than the number of rooms n, both within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): all(2 <= x[j] <= n[i] for j in range(k[i]))
preconditions.description: Each friend is in a room numbered between 2 and n.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): len(set(x[i])) == k[i]
preconditions.description: No two friends are in the same room.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): len(corridors[i]) == n[i] - 1
preconditions.description: There are exactly n-1 corridors for each test case.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): all(1 <= u <= n[i] and 1 <= v <= n[i] for u, v in corridors[i])
preconditions.description: Each corridor connects two valid rooms.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.
